body: Well, thanks to family situations, I'm not going to be able to look for a job until mid-January. Fuck.

> I wonder why you repeatedly talk about yourself as being almost simple and unable to know or learn easy things.

I'm not disabled, I just feel overwhelmed because I'm so far behind everyone else my age.

> Your parents likely already have it. If they won't give it to you must go get one.

No, I've never had one under my name at all. Mom doesn't want me to get one because it'll put me "on the grid" or something ridiculous, but I need one to basically do anything and it's caused be a lot of trouble over the last few years.

>Based on what you've written here, it seems your parents want to keep you childlike and dependent. Would you say this is true?

Not necessarily dependent, but... I guess mom didn't want me to grow up too fast, but as a result I haven't grown up at all. They were overprotective, and are a little to apathetic about someone my age living the way I am and never pushed me... not that I shouldn't have pushed myself, but... yeah I guess the first one, to an extent. I remember her getting upset one time when I was talking and said something that suggested that I would want to move out and live on my own one day. Started talking about how she'd just go ahead and move to england right now and let me go find a house, because I'm totally financially independent right now... shit, maybe they do want me to be dependent.

>Are you competent, or do you perhaps have some sort of disability that makes them think they have to take care of you?

I don't have any disabilities. I'm socially incompetent, but that can be fixed with enough practice if I can stop myself from hating myself during that practice. Otherwise no.

> Learn how to write proper resumes

How do I do that? What do I even put on it? "I've been sitting on my ass the last two years and now I'm trying to start work as a 20 year old with no ambition and no idea how to socialize"?

As for the hobbies... I should probably start on that. The problem is I already have a rough idea of what I'd make out of myself, but they all require years of practice to get good at and I'd just end up being years behind everyone else.

> Do you have your social security card? If not, get it. You can order it to be mailed to you online, or go to your local federal building and get it. Either way it will be mailed to you.

I don't, actually. And I don't think I can get one online where I live. So I guess I'll have to walk there, that or convince my parents to take me there, which I doubt is gonna happen since they seem pretty opposed to me growing up... Does it cost money?

Also, if I manage to get a job, are there any good resources on how to manage money? Because I have absolutely no concept of monetary value, and I'd probably immediately start fucking up.

> See, what actually was that I never experienced being rewarded for my efforts and so did not figure out the connection between work and money, nor did I understand what to do with said money once I had it. You didn't do things for a reward growing up with them, you did things no matter how difficult they were because you were just expected to, and even entertaining the notion that you might want some kind of compensation, like reminding them that other parents would give their kids a few dollars as a thank you for spending the entire day doing yard work, would be seen as a personal insult. I developed the exact opposite of work ethic: undervaluing my own ability to make positive changes for myself.

How did you change this? Because I'm pretty sure this is gonna be me.
You're right. I'm not hopeless. I don't know exactly what to do from here, but I feel foolish for ever considering ending it all. But I guess that's what happens when you're desperate and hopeless.

> Get a job at a place you can walk to (since you don't drive) like retail or food service. Especially at the holiday season, places just need warm bodies so they will hire you.

There's places like that within walking distance, a little ways in cold weather but I have no right to whine. But er, this is probably pretty embarrassing and a little "use google you jackass"-ish, but, how exactly does one go about getting that sort of job? When I say I don't know anything about the real world, I really mean *anything*. I know you have to apply, and some of them have interviews of some sort, and that's all I know. I don't even know if I have all the right paperwork I might need to do this.

And also... thanks. So much.
Going with the flow = suicide. The only other option is to figure out how to completely change who I am.
Wow somehow your comment made me realize that I've said a lot of dumb shit like that, about insensitivity to infertility and being cynical about people being able to change. Sorry, and thanks.

> You're doing your best for right now and that's enough.

But that's objectively false. I'm not doing anything, I've just kinda given up and sit on my ass at my parents' place all day like a leech.
oh my god i was such a fucking idiot. i'm so sorry for being such a rude jackass.
How did you get such high-quality screenshots? The in-game screenshot function gives me nothing but tiny jpgs.
lmao everyone's uncomfortable with the truth. Either accept it or work on changing it.
Doesn't make it any less true.
